why: Only the guard's source files must be the same code. Left out on purpose, because they differ by design: the hook tests and fixtures (the kit's use placeholder values, a kit-project fixture and skips for files only a person pastes), guard-entry.mjs (its error message names the project's path, and it steps aside for the project's own guard), budget-cap.mjs and its test (the release plugin reads kit.json budgets and scripts/ beside hooks/), and step-aside.mjs (kit only). Kit paths are relative to the kit's root; `kitOnly` lists the kit-only step-aside lines (Hutzup 3.3.3), dropped from the kit side before the compare.
kitOnly: // The project's own denied-log writes the line; a second copy would log it twice.
